name: No Good Deed Will Go Unpunished
overview: Scripture acknowledges that doing good does not always shield believers from hardship or opposition, as Jesus himself faced rejection despite demonstrating many good works (John 10:32). The righteous may experience trials and tribulations, yet these challenges produce perseverance and spiritual growth (Romans 5:3). While evildoers may prosper temporarily, God assures that the wicked will not escape punishment and that the righteous will ultimately be delivered (Proverbs 11:21; Psalms 37:1). God's impartial care over both the just and unjust reminds believers to trust His sovereign justice and love, exemplified supremely in the gift of His Son for eternal life (Matthew 5:45; John 3:16).
